# Feature candidates

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

When the user asks for startup options, that ask names only `/crav1-spark-to-spec`, `/crav1-ideas-to-spec`, `/crav1-bundle-to-specs`, `/crav1-existing-to-specs`, `/crav1-read-environment`, and `/crav1-fix-bug`.

`/crav1-ado-sync` runs it when that command needs the list.

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-ado-sync
```

## Steps

### What it reads

`docs/system/landscape.md` (the spec index and its statuses, Ideas, Way of working, and code with no slice), `docs/system/repos.md`, the glossary, every `docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md`, and `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, and `verify.md` where they exist. It also reads `docs/research/` and `docs/sources/`, and each fact from those folders is labelled by where it came from. It reads open notes in `docs/notes/`. It reads each spec’s `work-item.md` and the landscape table `## No spec yet in ADO`.

### What one row is

A spec that holds only open questions is marked `questions only`, and the questions are in the description so they can be handled in the Feature discussion. An item with no spec, from sources, the landscape, or code with no slice, is marked `no spec yet`.

### What the user sees

A numbered table: title, target date and its source, spec (or `no spec yet` or `questions only`), and the id already recorded.

## After

Reference page: [ado-sync](reference/skills/crav1-ado-sync.md)

The run ends as [How a run ends](reference/run-ending.md) says: Run next, never a `Next:` line, `Waiting:` only when a step is blocked, and `Uncommitted:` when files changed and are not committed.
